dialogue_texts: Phew. Things are getting tougher than it looks, but it doesn't change my reason to keep searching for her.
The Scarlet Devil isn't looking to speak with anyone at the moment.
More importantly, I'm looking for the one who assassinated my husband nine months ago.
King Kourin was responsible for vanquishing the one who killed my mother when I was two.
Did you think that killing my husband would stop the spread of Crimsonitism?
Yet his legacy will live on via his wife and the mother of Remilia and Flandre Scarlet.
My grunts are hoping to bring vengeance over the love of my life.
I'm not here for a lecture on family hierarchy. I'm here for answers.
I think that if you're who I think you are, I won't tell you where Flandre is. She is not in the mansion right now.
Are you kidding me? There should be a deflection in finding her.
I'm afraid I can't tell you.
That's a shame. I guess I'll have to learn the hard way.
You speak of my daughters as if they are mere subjects to be managed.
Perhaps you've forgotten your place, shrine maiden.
I'm not staying in what I experienced in the timespan between the deaths of my mother and your husband.
I'm sure you're asking me for a rematch.
Then let me see if your skills match your arrogance.
If you want the truth, you'll have to earn it.
